title: Doesn’t stick no matter how clean the tile
text: Doesn’t stick no matter how clean the tile. I used these across two apartments and do not recommend. In my first apartment; the unit stayed stuck to the wall for about two weeks before one side began to fall daily. At my new place, this comes crashing down every five minutes and I had to throw away. And yes, I am following the instructions to a t.

product_metadata.title: ilikable Vacuum Shower Caddy Suction Cup No-Drilling Removable Waterproof Bathroom Wall Shelf Shower Basket Storage Organizer for Shampoo Conditioner Razors Soap - White
features: POWERFUL HEAVY DUTY SUCTION CUP - Max Hold to 22 LB - Our shower organizer suction cup use exclusive patented technology suction cup design principle. This bathroom shower organizer can hold up to 10KG/ 22LB. It can firmly stick the wall for 1000 days without falling.

NO NEED TOOLS & ANTI DAMAGE - The suction cup bathroom organizer can complete the installation in ONE second. Just press the hook "Push" with the palm of your hand, and you can install it successfully after hearing a "puff" sound. Please clean the wall before installation.

UNIQUE VENTILATION AND DRAINAGE DESIGN - This shower suction shelf bottom is sloping design(-6° tilt). Combining with hollowed bottom design can effectively drain excess water, prevent stagnant water and keep the contents dry.

EDGE GROOVE HOOK - SAVING MORE SPACE - The side of the shower organizer has groove hook which can hang small bathroom supplies such as razors, bath balls, head ropes, necklaces, bracelets, etc. The wall-mounted shower caddy can be decorated in anywhere you want, to storage shampoo, conditioner, soap and kitchen tools.
ilikable Bathroom Shower Storage Organizer include Two Vacuum Suction Cup, One Shower Rack, One Removal Card, One Instruction Manual
